problem_statement: There is no staged way to append a TLV to a message whose length is not known in advance. A caller should be able to reserve a TLV header placeholder, append the value bytes to the message afterward (appending as many pieces as needed, including values that grow past the standard TLV length and must become an extended TLV), and then finalize the header with the correct length and type, promoting to an extended header when needed. The test drives this Start/Adjust/End sequence for lengths of 3, 254 (max base TLV), 255 (forcing an extended TLV), and 300 (forcing promotion during the append loop), and checks the resulting TLV type, length, value bytes, and message length.
